profile.headline: Staff Pricing Analyst at Viasat
profile.summary: Strategic and analytical professional with experience in the Defense & Space, Government, and Commercial industries, specializing in developing cost-effective pricing solutions. Proven ability to analyze market trends, assess risk, and contribute to winning pricing strategies. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a focus on delivering value to both customers and the organization. Seeking a manager role to leverage financial expertise and strategic thinking to optimize pricing and profitability.

positions.title: Principal Proposal Analyst
positions.description:
Pre-RFP
Work with Program Management to establish executable schedules with milestones to accommodate customers' needs. 
Develop labor and supplier estimating targets based on historical data.
Assist Program and Contracts teams with Negotiation/profit strategy.

Proposal Development
Proposal framework setup in response to the request for proposal (RFP) and technical requirements of Statement of Work (SOW).
Development of strong labor estimates utilizing historical cost data in coordination with technical expertise from the integrated product teams (IPTs).
Analysis of supplier estimates established by the Global Supply Chain (GSC) estimating team.
Assess cost confidence and risk of proposal and work with program management on plan to mitigate risk and harvest opportunities. 
Present submittal/negotiation/business deal approval request to leadership in a clear and concise package.

Post-submittal
Respond to requests for information (RFIs) from the customer as well as DCAA/DCMA.
Support Negotiations with counter offers and additional justification.

positions.title: Project Manager Team Lead
positions.description:
- Developed prototypes and tested for malfunctions to insure successful production and reduction of spending on unnecessary cost.
- Designed portions of the robot after precise calculations and revisions that enabled the team to move forward in a timely manner.
- Developed ideas for fundraisers to be used towards the goals of the organization.
